mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.7% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.7%.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightness condition defined by UNRATE falling below 4.5% signals robust employment growth, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong aggregate demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% annualized and industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeding 1%, sustained corporate profitability drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting the late-cycle expansion regime criteria.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 105 (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output, generating short-term equity momentum and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO remains above 105.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly employment growth exceeding 100k (PAYEMS increase > 100k) signals accelerating labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases by more than 100k.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low FEDFUNDS (below 0.7%) and low CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL annual growth < 2%) creates a stable monetary environment that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.7% and CPIAUCSL annual growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A supply-driven expansion regime defined by INDPRO above 105 indicates strong manufacturing output, which increases corporate capital expenditure and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.
